about: Mainnet contracts and accounts linked to Stellar Light directory projects, each with why (evidence), how strong (tier), the public page it was read from (sourceUrl) and, where proved, when it was created: a contract's creation or an account's opening found in that ledger's own metadata from an archive RPC (createdLedger, createdAt; an account's opening is not a launch date). Built 2026-11-21 to 2026-11-24 read-only from public sources: the directory, the projects' own repos, pages, stellar.toml files and SCF proposals, Stellar Index, stellar-expert/public-directory, Horizon and the ledger itself. The own-code test was checked on contracts whose owner was already known: it called 1 of 112 other projects' contracts its own and recognised 53 of 70 own contracts, so a contract missing here is not proof it is not the project's. An address linked to more than one project is linked to none, except within an issuer-and-token family (kept for each member, one tier down, sharedWithinFamily naming them, issuer first) and the groups given to one member by hand (src/lib/onchain-map.ts). A contract whose only evidence is its code (a protocol registry, a code proof) is left out when the account that created it deployed another project's own contracts and none of this one's: a registry lists every contract that runs a protocol's code, whoever runs it. Weaker links (named on the project's own pages only, or the same deployer only) are left out. Built by scripts/build-onchain-map.ts; read by the on-chain lane, which serves the links on project rows (onchain.contracts, onchain.accounts) and on /api/contracts and re-checks each week that every address still exists.

evidenceKinds.directory: already in the Stellar Light directory for this project
evidenceKinds.own-repo-interface: named in a deployment or config file of the project's repo, and the deployed code exposes the functions one of the project's repos defines
evidenceKinds.own-wasm-meta: named in the project's repo, and the deployed code's own metadata (SEP-55 source_repo) names a repo of the project
evidenceKinds.own-pages-confirmed: named on the project's own pages or SCF proposal, and the code is tied to the project as above
evidenceKinds.own-deployer-confirmed: created by the account that deployed one of the project's proved contracts, and the code is the project's too
evidenceKinds.own-account: an account whose home domain points back to the project's site, or one its stellar.toml declares
evidenceKinds.protocol-registry: the anchor contract (factory, or the earliest contract) of a protocol in Stellar Index's registry
evidenceKinds.public-directory-label: stellar-expert/public-directory labels the address under the project's own domain (entries flagged malicious or unsafe are left out)
evidenceKinds.named-on-own-pages: named on the project's own pages
evidenceKinds.same-deployer: created by the account that deployed one of the project's proved contracts

tiers.strong: the directory, a code proof, a protocol registry anchor or the project's own account
tiers.labelled: a public-directory label under the project's own domain (a third party's label, not a verification), or an address shared within an issuer-and-token family
